issue_description: parse_date() crashes with ValueError on ISO-8601 timestamps containing timezone offsets, e.g. parse_date('2026-10-01T12:00:00+09:00'). Invalid date strings must still raise ValueError.
patch_diff:
--- a/dateutils/parser.py
+++ b/dateutils/parser.py
@@ -10,4 +10,7 @@
 def parse_date(s):
-    return _legacy_parse(s)
+    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(s)
+    if dt.tzinfo is not None:
+        return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+    return dt
